summary: The change darkens the primary and primary-hover colors in both color schemes, bringing the white primary-button text comfortably above the required 4.5:1 contrast while retaining the blue identity.

evidence: public/styles.css:12-14 and 61-63 set --primary to #0066cc and --primary-hover to #005bb5 in both light and dark schemes, paired with #ffffff.
White text on #0066cc has approximately 5.57:1 contrast, and on #005bb5 approximately 6.65:1 contrast; both exceed 4.5:1.
The shared #login primary-button rule consumes --primary and --primary-hover for its base and hover states, so both affected button states inherit the compliant colors.
